method: M4 Procedural 2D Compositor + existing runtime DoorLayer motion

material.note: Door material is deliberately close to the accepted wall family but slightly lighter so the moving leaf reads without becoming a focal neon element.

qa.open: leaves retract 104% into wall pockets; no guide rails remain through the aperture
